paragraphs: The M135i xDrive is the performance flagship of the F40-generation 1 Series, produced from 2019 to 2024. It uses the B48 — a 2.0-litre turbocharged four-cylinder petrol engine, part of BMW's modular B-series family that replaced the earlier N-series engines. The B48 is widely regarded as a more reliable design than its predecessors, with a closed-deck block and improved thermal management. In M135i xDrive specification, it produces around 302bhp, making it one of the most powerful production four-cylinder engines BMW has offered.
about.boldParagraph: The M135i xDrive is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

compatibility.intro: The M135i xDrive uses the B48 engine exclusively across its entire F40 production run. Unlike some variants that span multiple engines across generations, this one is consistent — if you have an F40 M135i xDrive, you have a B48. However, the B48 has multiple variants with different power outputs and component specifications, so we still confirm your exact engine code by registration before quoting or supplying any parts or service.
